edits.prompt:
Edit this illustrated tabletop board concept. Preserve its three side-by-side regions, colourful cartoon illustration style, physical rounded cardboard board and warm ivory backdrop. Preserve the pleasant pond at left, lush green meadow in the middle, barren rocky wasteland at right, and the two wonderfully cosy refuges in the wasteland.
CHANGE THE ROUTE TO ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS NON-BRANCHING PATH with a clearly identifiable start and end. Replace the existing disconnected trails, loops and bridge junctions. The overall route is like THREE large adjacent open U-shaped excursions connected at their upper ends. Each U occupies one biome and has two well separated legs, so it suggests a long loop through that landscape without ever closing into a circle.
Exact visual journey: start near the pond in the UPPER LEFT of region 1; walk DOWN its left leg, curve around its lower area, walk UP its right leg; cross a short horizontal wooden bridge near the UPPER part of boundary 1 into the LEFT leg of region 2; walk DOWN the middle region's left leg, around its lower meadow and UP its right leg; cross a second short horizontal wooden bridge near the UPPER part of boundary 2 into the LEFT leg of region 3; walk DOWN the wasteland's left leg, around its lower refuge and UP its right leg to END in the cosy rock-overhang spring at the UPPER RIGHT. Thus the path is a connected wave of three deep U bends. It has exactly two ends, two connecting bridges, zero forks and no extra branches, closed loops, disconnected path patches or scenery paths.
Use substantial organically shaped stepping clearings and flat stones as the continuous path, approximately consistent game-piece footprint, no repeated circles or numbering. Important: the middle region's comfortable rests and the two final-region refuges ARE enlarged individual stopping clearings ON that same path, replacing ordinary path patches; they are not separate destinations off the path. The path should pass directly through the comfy lower hollow and terminate at the cosy spring. Keep the generous open path visually distinct from decorative landscape rocks.
No text, numerals, reward symbols, arrows, UI, tokens, new characters or new panels. Keep it a beautiful board concept, no exact 54-position claim. All content fully within the board. Highest priority is a visibly traceable single path that supports the user's three-biome journey.

Edit this seed-tile concept sheet with ONE targeted change: place the existing three physical cardboard tokens on a clean fully opaque warm ivory tabletop background, with tidy subtle soft contact shadows. Remove transparency, black empty background, any coloured edge fringe, speckling and rough cutout halos. Preserve all three token face designs, seed artwork, orange rims, blank lower value areas, outer shapes (rounded triangle, seed shape and rounded hexagon), order and relative scale. Preserve the flat cartoon artwork and tangible cardboard edges. Leave generous clean margins around all three complete tokens, no clipping. Do not add text, labels, numerals or other objects. Output a polished simple board-game component concept sheet, fully opaque.
